name: Piura, Peru · March 2017 flood
interpretation: March 11 is before the documented late-March escalation, not a proven dry-season baseline. April 4 represents ongoing/remaining inundation, not peak extent. No recession label is established.
selection_policy: Exclude mid/late-March baseline candidates because flooding was already developing. Require catalogue geometry, orbit, mode and VV compatibility; rank full coverage and same platform, then nearest event observation and latest baseline. Reuse processed data only after these checks.

evidence.title: INDECI: national emergency declaration, March 29
evidence.finding: Documents March 27 overflow and escalation from March 25; earlier seasonal emergency already existed.

evidence.title: UNOSAT: Radarsat-2 observation, March 24
evidence.finding: River overflow and wet fields before the March 27 escalation; preliminary, not field validated.

evidence.title: Agro Rural: Lower Piura inundation, April 3
evidence.finding: Reports breached dikes and inundation isolating Lower Piura communities.

evidence.title: EUMETSAT: April 4 satellite observation
evidence.finding: Coarse optical imagery shows water and sediment south of Piura; contextual evidence, not a 20 m flood truth mask.
